name: Additional Runecloth
label: Quest
description: Additional Runecloth: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings once again, friend! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of the Undercity.
Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend - without heroes like you working on behalf of the tribe, we'd surely suffer. Thank you for your continued efforts!
